# BTR role-only candidate

This NOT-QUALIFIED fixture narrows only membership root 101 to the independently
proved root 101/root 151 coupled template and makes the exact PAUSER self-admin
word explicit. All unrelated baseline fields and guards are unchanged.

Direct whitelist scalar 555 and index 556 remain inherited partial permissions:
nonzero array mutations refuse, while zero-address add/sole-remove may pass with
equal array stores omitted or ignored. This is not full whitelist admission.

`source-review.json` binds the frozen complete Phase A captures, compiler output,
primary source artifact, operation/compiler reports and transcripts. The helper

Public custom token source and deployed/proxy/producer/package qualification
remain open. Regenerate with `prepare_btr_role ORIGINAL_PACKAGE_ROOT FRESH_OUTPUT`.
See the [focused contract](../../../docs/btr-coupled-role-candidate.md).
